heading.en: Early career and the Red 25th Army

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，徐海東1900年6月17日生於湖北黃陂的窯工家庭，1925年春赴武漢投身革命並加入中國共產黨，1926年加入北伐軍，參加汀泗橋戰役和武昌戰役。1932年11月紅25軍重建時任第74師師長，1933年2月升任副軍長；同年秋折回皖西北組建紅28軍並任軍長，1934年3月葛藤山戰鬥中將敵54師161旅大部殲滅。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Xu Haidong was born on 17 June 1900 into a kiln-worker family in Huangpi, Hubei, went to Wuhan in spring 1925 to join the revolution and joined the Communist Party, and in 1926 joined the Northern Expedition army, taking part in the Dingsiqiao and Wuchang campaigns. When the Red 25th Army was re-formed in November 1932 he became commander of its 74th Division and in February 1933 its deputy commander; that autumn he went back to western Anhui, formed the Red 28th Army and commanded it, and in the March 1934 Getengshan fighting destroyed most of the enemy 54th Division's 161st Brigade.

citations.quote: 1900年6月17日生于湖北省黄陂县徐家桥村（今属大悟县）一个窑工家庭
1925年春前往武汉投身革命，并加入中国共产党
1926年6月在赴广东途中加入北伐军，参加了著名的汀泗桥战役和武昌战役
1932年11月红25军重建时，任该军第74师师长。1933年2月升任副军长
同年秋在由皖西北向鄂东北转移途中，部队遭敌人截击，前后失去联系。
折回皖西北，组建红28军并任军长
如在1934年3月的葛藤山战斗中，他先以两个营向一座山头佯动，迷惑和调动敌人
将敌54师161旅大部歼灭

heading.en: Long March and the Red 15th Army Corps

body.zh-Hant: 1934年11月16日紅25軍自河南羅山出發長征；出發前他主動提出由程子華任軍長，自己改任副軍長。1935年9月15日部隊抵達延川永坪鎮，與劉志丹的陝北紅軍會師，合編為紅15軍團，他任軍團長，連續取得勞山戰役和榆林橋戰鬥的勝利，並與紅1軍團取得直羅鎮戰役勝利。1936年2月參加東征，5月參加西征，12月任中央革命軍事委員會委員。
body.en: On 16 November 1934 the Red 25th Army set out from Luoshan, Henan, on the Long March; before departure he proposed that Cheng Zihua serve as army commander while he became deputy commander. On 15 September 1935 the force reached Yongping township in Yanchuan and joined Liu Zhidan's Shaanbei Red Army; the two were merged into the Red 15th Army Corps with Xu as corps commander, which won the Laoshan campaign and the Yulinqiao fighting and, with the Red 1st Army Corps, the Zhiluozhen campaign. He joined the Eastern Expedition in February 1936 and the Western Expedition in May, and in December became a member of the Central Revolutionary Military Commission.

citations.quote: 1934年11月16日，遵照中共中央创建新苏区的指示
部队出发前，他主动提出由中央派来的程子华同志担任军长，自己改任副军长。
9月15日率部到达延川县永坪镇，同刘志丹领导的陕北红军会师
citations.evidenceNote: 年份取自前文敘述序列（推論）

citations.quote: 两军随即合编为红15军团，他任军团长，指挥部队连续取得劳山战役和榆林桥战斗的胜利
指挥所部会同红1军团取得直罗镇战役的胜利
1936年2月参加东征，威逼太原。5月参加西征，直捣三边（靖边、安边、定边）
12月任中央革命军事委员会委员
citations.evidenceNote: 年份取自前文敘述序列（推論）

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰初期他任八路軍第115師344旅旅長，參加平型關戰鬥，指揮溫塘、張店和町店等戰鬥；1938年8月病倒後返回延安療養。1939年9月隨劉少奇赴華中，任新四軍江北指揮部副總指揮兼第4支隊司令員，同年12月抱病指揮反掃蕩並取得周家崗戰鬥勝利；1940年1月再度吐血，此後長期卧病。1955年中央決定授他大將軍銜，他1970年3月25日在鄭州含恨去世。
body.en: In the early war against Japan he was commander of the 344th Brigade of the Eighth Route Army's 115th Division, fought at Pingxingguan and commanded the Wentang, Zhangdian and Tingdian engagements; he collapsed in August 1938 and returned to Yan'an to recuperate. In September 1939 he went to central China with Liu Shaoqi as deputy commander of the New Fourth Army's Jiangbei Command and commander of its 4th Detachment, and that December he led the anti-sweep fighting at Zhoujiagang despite illness; in January 1940 he again coughed blood and was bedridden for a long period. In 1955 the Party decided to confer the rank of General on him; he died on 25 March 1970 in Zhengzhou.

citations.quote: 抗日战争初期，徐海东任八路军第115师344旅旅长，率部奔赴华北抗日前线
参加了著名的平型关战斗和晋察冀边区反“八路围攻”、晋东南反“九路围攻”，指挥了温塘、张店和町店等战斗
于1938年8月病倒在战场上，不得不返回延安疗养
于1939年9月随刘少奇前往华中，任新四军江北指挥部副总指挥兼第4支队司令员
同年12月任中共中央中原局委员，抱病指挥反“扫荡”，取得周家岗战斗的胜利
1940年1月在一次战斗总结会上再次吐血，晕倒在讲台上，从此长期卧病休养
1955年，中央根据他的历史功绩，决定授予他大将军衔
1970年3月25日含恨去世

heading.en: Early years and southern Zhejiang guerrilla war

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，粟裕1907年8月10日生於湖南會同；1927年6月轉入中國共產黨，8月參加南昌起義，1928年1月參加湘南起義，4月隨隊轉移到井岡山。1935年2月他任挺進師師長，與政治委員劉英率五百餘人挺進浙江腹地，開闢浙南游擊根據地。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Su Yu was born on 10 August 1907 in Huitong, Hunan; he joined the Communist Party in June 1927, took part in the Nanchang Uprising in August, joined the southern Hunan uprising in January 1928 and moved to the Jinggangshan base in April. In February 1935 he became commander of the Advance Division and, with political commissar Liu Ying, led over 500 men into the heart of Zhejiang and opened up the southern Zhejiang guerrilla base.

citations.quote: 1907年8月10日生于湖南会同
同年6月转入中国共产党，8月参加南昌起义，任警卫队班长。
1928年1月参加湘南起义，4月随队转移到井冈山
1935年2月任挺进师师长，同政治委员刘英一道，率500余人挺进国民党统治的腹地浙江
开辟浙南游击根据地

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰時期，粟裕1938年4月任新四軍第2支隊副司令員、先遣支隊司令員，6月首戰韋崗告捷；1940年7月率部渡江，任新四軍蘇北指揮部副指揮兼參謀長，10月參與指揮黃橋戰役；1941年1月皖南事變後任新四軍第1師師長、蘇中軍區司令員兼政治委員，1944年3月起組織車橋戰役；1945年1月任蘇浙軍區司令員兼政治委員，組織指揮天目山戰役。
body.en: During the war against Japan, Su Yu became deputy commander of the New Fourth Army's 2nd Detachment and commander of its Advance Detachment in April 1938, winning the first fight at Weigang in June; in July 1940 he crossed the Yangtze and became deputy commander and chief of staff of the Subei Command, and in October helped direct the Huangqiao campaign. After the New Fourth Army Incident of January 1941 he became commander of the 1st Division and commander and political commissar of the Central Jiangsu Military Region, organised the Qiaoche campaign from March 1944, and in January 1945 became commander and political commissar of the Su-Zhe Military Region, directing the Tianmushan campaign.

heading.zh-Hant: 華中野戰軍與華東野戰軍
heading.en: Central China and East China Field Armies

body.zh-Hant: 日本投降後，粟裕任華中軍區副司令員、華中野戰軍司令員，1945年12月指揮高郵戰役。1946年7月發起蘇中戰役，一個半月內七戰七捷，殲敵5.3萬餘人。1947年1月下旬山東、華中野戰軍合併為華東野戰軍，他任副司令員，隨即指揮萊蕪戰役；5月孟良崮戰役中全殲整編第74師。
body.en: After Japan's surrender Su Yu became deputy commander of the Central China Military Region and commander of the Central China Field Army, and in December 1945 directed the Gaoyou campaign. In July 1946 he launched the Central Jiangsu campaign, winning seven battles in a month and a half and wiping out over 53,000 enemy troops. In late January 1947 the Shandong and Central China Field Armies merged into the East China Field Army with him as deputy commander; he then directed the Laiwu campaign, and in May the Menglianggu campaign destroyed the reorganised 74th Division.

heading.zh-Hant: 解放戰爭後期與建國後

body.zh-Hant: 1948年5月陳毅調任中原軍區後，粟裕出任華東野戰軍代司令員兼代政治委員；同年9月指揮濟南戰役，僅用8天攻克濟南；淮海戰役中指揮所部圍殲黃百韜兵團和杜聿明集團共44萬餘人，1949年4月參加渡江戰役，5月指揮上海戰役。其後1951年任副總參謀長，1954年任總參謀長，1984年2月5日在北京病逝。
body.en: After Chen Yi was transferred to the Central Plains Military Region in May 1948, Su Yu served as acting commander and acting political commissar of the East China Field Army; in September he directed the Jinan campaign, taking the city in only eight days. In the Huai-Hai campaign his forces encircled and destroyed the Huang Baitao army group and the Du Yuming group, some 440,000 men in all; in April 1949 he took part as a main force in the Yangtze crossing and in May directed the Shanghai campaign. He became deputy chief of the general staff in 1951 and chief of the general staff in 1954, and died in Beijing on 5 February 1984.

heading.en: Early years and the Red 4th Army

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，羅瑞卿1906年5月31日生於四川南充；1926年加入共青團並考取武漢中央軍事政治學校，1928年在上海轉入中國共產黨。1929年5月任閩西紅軍第59團參謀長，1930年10月任紅4軍第11師政治委員，1932年3月任紅4軍政治委員，與軍長王良指揮部隊在漳州戰役中擔任主攻。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Luo Ruiqing was born on 31 May 1906 in Nanchong, Sichuan; in 1926 he joined the Communist Youth League and passed the entrance examination of the Wuhan Central Military and Political School, and in 1928 he transferred into the Communist Party in Shanghai. In May 1929 he became chief of staff of the 59th Regiment of the western Fujian Red Army, in October 1930 political commissar of the Red 4th Army's 11th Division, and in March 1932 political commissar of the Red 4th Army, which with army commander Wang Liang took the main assault role in the Zhangzhou campaign.

citations.quote: 1906年5月31日生于四川省南充市舞凤乡清泉坝
同年加入中国共产主义青年团，并以优异成绩考取武汉中央军事政治学校
1928年到上海，与中共党组织取得联系，转入中国共产党
5月任闽西红军第59团参谋长
citations.evidenceNote: 年份取自前文1929年之敘述序列（推論）

citations.quote: 10月任红4军第11师政治委员
citations.evidenceNote: 年份取自前文1930年之敘述序列（推論）

citations.quote: 1932年3月任红4军政治委员，与军长王良指挥部队在漳州战役中担任主攻

heading.en: Long March and the war against Japan

body.zh-Hant: 1934年10月他參加長征，途中任中央紅軍先遣隊參謀長，參與指揮強渡大渡河戰鬥。1936年6月起任紅軍大學（1937年1月改稱抗日軍政大學）教育長、副校長；1940年5月任八路軍野戰政治部主任，轉戰太行山區，參與指揮百團大戰。1945年6月當選中共第七屆中央候補委員。
body.en: In October 1934 he joined the Long March, serving en route as chief of staff of the Central Red Army's vanguard detachment and helping direct the forced crossing of the Dadu River. From June 1936 he was dean of studies and then deputy president of the Red Army University (renamed the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University in January 1937); in May 1940 he became director of the Eighth Route Army's Field Political Department, campaigned in the Taihang mountains and helped direct the Hundred Regiments Offensive. In June 1945 he was elected an alternate member of the CCP's Seventh Central Committee.

citations.quote: 1934年10月参加长征，途中曾任中央红军先遣队参谋长，参与指挥强渡大渡河战斗
1936年6月起任中国工农红军大学（1937年1月改称抗日军政大学）教育长、副校长
1940年5月任八路军野战政治部主任，转战太行山区，参与指挥百团大战
1945年6月当选为中共第七届中央候补委员

body.zh-Hant: 1946年6月羅瑞卿任晉察冀野戰軍政治委員，參與指揮大同集寧、張家口等戰役，並在1947年10、11月的清風店戰役和石家莊戰役中發揮政治工作作用。1948年5月華北軍區成立後任政治部主任兼第2兵團第一政治委員，平津戰役中將國民黨軍第35軍大部殲滅於新保安，1949年3月赴山西參加太原戰役。
body.en: In June 1946 Luo Ruiqing became political commissar of the Jin-Cha-Ji Field Army and took part in directing the Datong-Jining, Zhangjiakou and other campaigns, and in the Qingfengdian and Shijiazhuang campaigns of October and November 1947 political work under him sustained the troops. After the North China Military Region was formed in May 1948 he became director of its political department and first political commissar of the 2nd Army Group; in the Pingjin campaign most of the Nationalist 35th Army was destroyed at Xinbao'an, and in March 1949 he went to Shanxi for the Taiyuan campaign.

citations.quote: 6月任晋察冀野战军政治委员，参与指挥大同集宁、张家口、易满、保南、正太、青沧、保北、大清河北等战役
citations.evidenceNote: 年份取自前文1946年初之敘述序列（推論）

citations.quote: 在1947年10月、11月的清风店战役和石家庄战役中
1948年5月晋察冀军区和晋冀鲁豫军区合并为华北军区后，任政治部主任兼第2兵团第一政治委员
将国民党军第35军大部歼灭于新保安
3月开赴山西，参加太原战役
citations.evidenceNote: 年份取自前文1949年1月之敘述序列（推論）

body.zh-Hant: 新中國成立後，羅瑞卿受命組建公安部並任部長；1959年4月任國務院副總理，同年9月起任軍委常委和秘書長、解放軍總參謀長、國防部副部長。1965年12月起遭林彪等人誣陷，被解除領導職務；1978年8月3日因病逝世。
body.en: After the founding of the People's Republic, Luo Ruiqing was tasked with forming the Ministry of Public Security and served as its minister; in April 1959 he became a vice premier of the State Council and from September that year secretary-general of the Central Military Commission, chief of the PLA General Staff and vice minister of national defence. Accused by Lin Biao and others from December 1965, he was removed from his posts, and he died of illness on 3 August 1978.

citations.quote: 新中国建立后，受命组建公安部并任部长
1959年4月任国务院副总理
9月起任中共中央军委常委和秘书长、人民解放军总参谋长、国防部副部长

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，羅榮桓1902年11月26日生於湖南衡山；1927年加入中國共產黨，8月參與組織通城秋收暴動，並任通城、崇陽農民自衛軍黨代表。1929年12月出席古田會議並當選紅4軍前敵委員會委員；1930年8月任紅4軍政治委員，1932年3月任紅1軍團政治部主任，4月參與指揮漳州戰役。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Luo Ronghuan was born on 26 November 1902 in Hengshan, Hunan; in 1927 he joined the Communist Party, and in August helped organise the Tongcheng Autumn Harvest Uprising and served as Party representative of the Tongcheng and Chongyang peasant self-defence forces. In December 1929 he attended the Gutian Conference and was elected to the Red 4th Army's Front Committee; in August 1930 he became political commissar of the Red 4th Army, and in March 1932 director of the Red 1st Army Corps' political department, helping direct the Zhangzhou campaign in April.

citations.quote: 1932年3月任红1军团政治部主任兼入闽作战的东路军政治部主任，4月参与指挥漳州战役

body.zh-Hant: 抗戰期間，羅榮桓任八路軍第115師政治部主任，1938年秋六屆六中全會後任115師政治委員。1939年3月初他隨師部東進魯西平原，首戰樊壩全殲偽軍1個團，8月參與指揮梁山戰鬥。1941年8月任中共中央山東分局委員、山東軍政委員會書記；1942年11月他指揮115師主力挺進隴海路，6天內連克海陵地區16處據點，殲敵千餘人。
body.en: During the war against Japan Luo Ronghuan was director of the 115th Division's political department of the Eighth Route Army, and after the Sixth Plenum of the Sixth Central Committee in autumn 1938 became its political commissar. In early March 1939 he moved with the division headquarters east into the western Shandong plain, wiping out a puppet regiment at Fanba in the first fight and helping direct the Liangshan fighting in August. In August 1941 he became a member of the CCP Shandong Bureau and secretary of the Shandong Military and Political Committee; in November 1942 he led the 115th Division's main force to the Longhai railway and in six days took 16 enemy strongpoints in the Hailing area, killing or wounding over a thousand.

citations.quote: 抗日战争爆发后，任八路军第115师政治部主任
同年秋参加在延安举行的中共六届六中全会，会后任115师政治委员

heading.en: Shandong Military Region and the northeast

body.zh-Hant: 1943年3月羅榮桓任山東軍區司令員兼政治委員，9月任中共中央山東分局書記，1945年6月當選中共第七屆中央委員。抗戰勝利後率山東主力進軍東北，1945年10月任東北人民自治軍第二政治委員，12月任東北民主聯軍副政治委員；1948年8月任東北野戰軍政治委員，參與指揮遼瀋戰役。1949年1月任第四野戰軍政治委員。
body.en: In March 1943 Luo Ronghuan became commander and political commissar of the Shandong Military Region, in September secretary of the CCP Shandong Bureau, and in June 1945 a member of the Seventh Central Committee. After the war he led the Shandong main force into the northeast: in October 1945 he became second political commissar of the Northeast People's Self-Defence Army and in December deputy political commissar of the Northeast Democratic Allied Army; in August 1948 he became political commissar of the Northeast Field Army and helped direct the Liaoshen campaign, and in January 1949 political commissar of the Fourth Field Army.

citations.quote: 1943年3月任山东军区司令员兼政治委员，115师政治委员、代师长，9月任中共中央山东分局书记
同年6月当选为中共第七届中央委员

1948年8月任东北军区第一副政治委员兼东北野战军政治委员，参与指挥辽沈战役
1949年1月任第四野战军政治委员

body.zh-Hant: 新中國成立後，羅榮桓1950年4月任總政治部主任，1955年組織實施全軍授銜授勳工作，並獲授元帥軍銜；1956年9月當選中共第八屆中央政治局委員，1961年1月復任總政治部主任，1963年12月16日在北京逝世。
body.en: After the founding of the People's Republic, Luo Ronghuan became director of the General Political Department in April 1950, organised the PLA-wide conferral of ranks and decorations in 1955 and was himself made a Marshal; in September 1956 he was elected to the Eighth Politburo, in January 1961 he again became director of the General Political Department, and he died in Beijing on 16 December 1963.

citations.quote: 1950年4月任人民解放军总政治部主任和总干部管理部部长
1955年组织实施了全军授衔、授勋工作
中华人民共和国元帅（1955）
1956年9月被选为中共第八届中央政治局委员
1961年1月复任总政治部主任
12月16日在北京逝世

heading.en: Early years, Whampoa and the Nanchang Uprising

body.zh-Hant: 據中國共產黨新聞網資料，聶榮臻1899年12月29日生於四川江津，1919年底赴法國勤工儉學，1923年春轉入中國共產黨。1925年9月回國，任黃埔軍校政治部秘書兼政治教官；1927年8月1日他組織國民革命軍第25師兩個多團起義，任起義軍第11軍黨代表。
body.en: According to the CPC News Network, Nie Rongzhen was born on 29 December 1899 in Jiangjin, Sichuan, went to France on a work-study programme at the end of 1919 and transferred into the Communist Party in spring 1923. Returning to China in September 1925 he became secretary of the political department and political instructor at the Whampoa Military Academy; on 1 August 1927 he organised the uprising of more than two regiments of the 25th Division of the National Revolutionary Army and became Party representative of the insurgent 11th Army.

1925年9月回国，被派到黄埔军校任政治部秘书兼政治教官

body.en: In January 1931 Nie Rongzhen became chief of staff of the newly formed Central Military Commission and in March 1932 political commissar of the Red 1st Army Corps. In January 1935 he directed the Red 1st Division's forced crossing of the Wu River and the occupation of Zunyi, and in May he concurrently became political commissar of the Central Red Army's vanguard detachment, forcing the Dadu River with its commander Liu Bocheng. In September 1937 he helped direct the Pingxingguan campaign, which wiped out over 1,000 men of the Japanese 5th Division's 21st Brigade.

heading.zh-Hant: 晉察冀軍區與抗戰戰役
heading.en: Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region and wartime battles

body.zh-Hant: 1937年10月聶榮臻奉命率115師主力一部留守五台山，任晉察冀軍區司令員兼政治委員；11月下旬起指揮部隊粉碎日軍2萬餘人的八路圍攻。1939年11月他指揮雁宿崖和黃土嶺戰鬥，擊斃日軍獨立混成第2旅旅長阿部規秀中將；1940年8月率部參加百團大戰，先後組織指揮39個團參戰；1945年8月任中共晉察冀中央局書記。
body.en: In October 1937 Nie Rongzhen was ordered to stay behind in the Wutaishan area with part of the 115th Division's main force and became commander and political commissar of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region; from late November he directed the defeat of the "eight-route encirclement" by over 20,000 Japanese troops. In November 1939 he directed the Yansuya and Huangtuling battles, in which Lieutenant General Abe Norihide, commander of the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade, was killed; in August 1940 he took part in the Hundred Regiments Offensive, organising and directing 39 regiments, and in August 1945 he became secretary of the CCP Jin-Cha-Ji Central Bureau.

body.zh-Hant: 1947年4月聶榮臻發起正太戰役，10至11月取得清風店、石家莊戰役勝利；1948年5月晉察冀、晉冀魯豫軍區合併為華北軍區，他出任司令員。1949年1月與林彪、羅榮桓組成平津前線總前委，6月任副總參謀長，1950年初任代理總參謀長；1955年9月獲授元帥軍銜，1992年5月14日在北京病逝。
body.en: In April 1947 Nie Rongzhen launched the Zhengtai campaign and in October-November won the Qingfengdian and Shijiazhuang campaigns; in May 1948 the Jin-Cha-Ji and Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu military regions merged into the North China Military Region, with him as commander. In January 1949 he formed the Pingjin Front General Committee with Lin Biao and Luo Ronghuan, in June became deputy chief of the general staff, and in early 1950 acting chief of the general staff; he was made a Marshal in 1955 and died in Beijing on 14 May 1992.
